search.method: a comparison ghost (the lab's ghosts), hand-built and checked by lab replay: the main demo with the second jump pressed on input 38, one tick after the landing. The landing tick (38) zeroes momentum.y (OnCollisionStay2D's floor case with no jump), so the jump is a full one (805, peak y -36.1): below y -600 on tick 85 and in the finish box on tick 100, 10 ticks after the main demo. Ghost path: its first 130 physics ticks (--path-ticks 130).
